command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_heat_1d.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Two homogeneous layers of thickness 0.65 and 0.85 m with different affine complex reservoir profiles. At 3.2 rad/s propagate [T,q,1,x] by a continuum matrix exponential per layer and impose the 0.27 m² K/W contact jump. Use resulting exterior Dirichlet values in the composed P2 SIPG model. Errors are maxima over the two material-side contact traces or fluxes.
